sections.title: L.H.Tower

fields.label: Height
fields.value: 6 Meter steel trestle above 3mtrs masonry structure

sections.text: Frame work tower (M.S. Trestle tower) and M.S room approx. 8'x8'x8' ( 4580 x 5310mm) over 15'x15' sq. masonry structure (Size height 8000 x 2310mm) of 3mtrs base height. Main angles are 65x65x6mm and other supportive angles 50x50x6mm are used for framing trestle tower structure. Top of the trestle 1 X 1 Meter G.I cabin to installed light equipment and keep inside 2nos SMF 12V/100AH battery and solar charge controller.

fields.label: b) Pedestal
fields.value: M.S Iron 100 X 100 cm G.I box over which provision has been made for installation of light. Inside the box arrangement has been made for installation of 2 Nos SMF12V/100AH battery and charge controller.
